questions.q: What did Yahweh say to Moses and Aaron was the condition of a man who has a flow of from his flesh?
questions.a: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron that any man who has a discharge coming from his genitals is impure.

questions.q: What happens to the person who touches the person who is unclean because he had a discharge?
questions.a: Anyone who touches the unclean person will be unclean himself and must bathe in water and wash his clothes, and he is unclean until evening.

questions.q: In what kind of water must the person being cleansed from an infected flow of fluid bathe?
questions.a: The person being cleansed from an infected flow of fluid must bathe in fresh water.

questions.q: What must the unclean man present to the priest for a sin offering and for a burnt offering?
questions.a: The unclean man must present to the priest two doves or two pigeons, one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

questions.q: What is the condition of anything or any person that has contact with a man’s semen?
questions.a: They must be washed in water and will be unclean until evening.

questions.q: How long will woman be impure as she menstruates?
questions.a: She will be impure for seven days.

questions.q: How long will a man be unclean if he sleeps with a woman who is menstruating, and her flow touches him?
questions.a: He shall be unclean for seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.

questions.q: What is a woman to bring as a sacrifice on the eight day after her flow of blood stops?
questions.a: She is to bring to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, two doves or two pigeons.

commentary.text: —We need not be curious in explaining these laws; but have reason to be thankful that we need fear no defilement, except that of sin, nor need ceremonial and burdensome purifications. These laws remind us that God sees all things, even those which escape the notice of men. The great gospel duties of faith and repentance are here signified, and the great gospel privileges of the application of Christ's blood to our souls for our justification, and his grace for our sanctification.
